title: KALLAX insert with 2 drawers
scope: Manual steps 1–15. 2 drawers; fitted in one compartment; excludes wall attachment.

overview.title: Check the parts
overview.hint: Check the hardware against p3. The hardware is supplied for 2 drawers: steps 2–9 are done once for each drawer.

1.title: Fold the frame
1.hint: Unfold the folding frame (the runners are already fitted to the side panels) and fold it into a U shape.

2.title: Connecting bolts in the front
2.hint: Lay the drawer front flat, inside face up, and screw in 2 connecting bolts. Do this for each of the two drawers.
2.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p5 — the connector bolts turn as they go in.

3.title: Insert the sides
3.hint: Hammer in 2 dowels, then insert the two side panels upright into the front.

4.title: Cam locks
4.hint: Fit the cam locks into the holes in the sides and turn them tight with a flat-blade screwdriver.
4.motionNote: Motion source: the curved arrow on the screwdriver in the right-hand detail circle on p6 — the cam lock turns in place (the manual gives no angle; half a turn is used).

5.title: Bottom
5.hint: Slide the bottom panel in along the grooves.

6.title: Back
6.hint: Press the back panel down into the notches at the top of the side panels.

7.title: Nail the back
7.hint: Fix the side panels to the back panel by hammering in nails.

8.title: Drawer runners
8.hint: Fit the left (123801) and right (123802) runners, 2 screws each.
8.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver in the step 8 detail circle on p8 — the screws turn as they go in.

9.title: Knob and bumper pads
9.hint: Screw the knob screw in from the inside of the front; stick bumper pads on the upper corners of the back of the front (1 sheet = 2 pads).
9.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver in step 9 on p8 — the knob screw turns as it goes in.

10.title: Mark line (Left)
10.hint: Place the marking gauge on the front edge of the compartment floor on the left side and draw a pencil line.

11.title: Mark line (Right)
11.hint: Draw a line on the right side in the same way.

12.title: Push in the frame
12.hint: Push the U-shaped frame into the compartment.

13.title: Left side screws
13.hint: On the left side, press the frame in, align it with the pencil line and drive in 2 screws.
13.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver in step 13 on p11 — the screws turn as they go in. Step 14 has no rotation arrow, so those screws do not turn.

14.title: Right side screws
14.hint: Do the same on the right side.

15.title: Push in the drawers
15.hint: Put the two drawers on the runners and push them in.
